changelog:
## 0.1.0 — First soft landing

- A reflection skill that doesn’t push you harder — just helps you see clearer  
- Turn messy days into simple insights  
- No pressure, no scoring, no “you should have done better”  
- Just a calm structure to process your thoughts and move forward  

Built as a thinking partner, not a productivity judge. More iterations coming.
summary: Helps you gently review and reflect on today, yesterday, or this week by organizing your thoughts into a clear, low-pressure summary.
